title: SHAREHOLDER ALERT: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman, LLC Announces Investigation of Apple, Inc. (AAPL)

organizations.name: gewirtz & grossman, llc announces investigation of apple, inc.

text:
NEW YORK , Jan. 30, 2018 /PRNewswire/ -- Attorney Advertising -- Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman, LLC is investigating potential claims on behalf of purchasers of Apple, Inc. ("Apple" or the "Company") (Nasdaq: AAPL ). Such investors are encouraged to obtain additional information and assist the investigation by visiting the firm's site: www.bgandg.com/aapl .  
The investigation concerns whether Apple and certain of its officers and/or directors have violated Sections federal securities laws.
On January 30, 2018 , media outlets reported that the U.S. Department of Justice and Securities Exchange Commission are investigating whether Apple's disclosures with respect to the software update at issue violated securities laws.  Following this news, Apple's share price has fallen during intraday trading on January 30, 2018 .
If you are aware of any facts relating to this investigation, or purchased shares of Apple, you can assist this investigation by visiting the firm's site: www.bgandg.com/aapl . You can also contact Peretz Bronstein or his Investor Relations Analyst, Yael Hurwitz of Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman, LLC: 212-697-6484.  
Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman, LLC is a corporate litigation boutique.  Our primary expertise is the aggressive pursuit of litigation claims on behalf of our clients.  In addition to representing institutions and other investor plaintiffs in class action security litigation, the firm's expertise includes general corporate and commercial litigation, as well as securities arbitration.   Attorney advertising. Prior results do not guarantee similar outcomes.
